hook: A smaller flat in Gurgaon costs more per square foot than a bigger one.
unit: per square foot · the most expensive band in the city
meaning: Size does not buy a discount here. The mid band is the most expensive floor in the market.
caption_extra: ₹13,706 for under 60 sqm. ₹21,184 for 60 to 110 sqm. ₹19,765 for over 110 sqm.

hook: Gurgaon's property records are public. Reaching them requires solving a captcha.
unit: HARERA search, deed dashboard, collector rates, deed search
meaning: Every statutory route into Haryana's own property data is gated. That is why Gurgaon is the hardest city we cover.
caption_extra: We checked all four. There is no non-captcha path.

hook: Nobody in India can honestly quote you a rental yield. Including us.
unit: the National Housing Bank announced one and never published it
meaning: Four cities, four incompatible municipal bases, none of them market rent. So we mark it as a gap instead of estimating it.
caption_extra: An announced index is not a published one.

hook: Gurgaon costs a third less than Mumbai per square foot, and its air is four times worse.
unit: micrograms per cubic metre · Mumbai reads 24
meaning: India's own daily standard is 60. Nobody publishes price and air quality against each other, so we started.
caption_extra: Mean across the city's monitoring stations. Latest reading, not a period average.

hook: Gurgaon rose 22.8 percent in a year. Your flat did not necessarily.
unit: city index · not a valuation of any single property
meaning: An index is a basket. It moves with what transacted and where. Your address is not the basket.
source: NHB RESIDEX press release · as of 2025-12-31
caption_extra: An index tells you about a market. Only a valuation tells you about a property.

hook: Circle rate is not market rate. The gap between them is the story.
unit: the state's floor, and what people actually paid
meaning: A narrow gap is a cold market. A wide one is a hot market, or a circle rate nobody has revised.
caption_extra: One is set by the state. One is set by people. Neither is useful alone.

hook: We will not quote you a listing price. Here is why.
unit: every figure sourced from statutory records, never from a portal
meaning: A listing price is what someone hopes to get. A registered price is what someone actually got. We build on the second.
caption_extra: It is why our coverage looks small. It is also why you can check every figure yourself.
